title: Other Discoveries, 1936-7: Jerusalem District, Jerusalem Sub-District. Jerusalem
author: (round-up, Department of Antiquities)
location_note: Municipal sewer trenches: Kidron Valley near Gethsemane, between the Pool of Siloam and Mount Zion, and along the north wall from Damascus Gate to Burj Laqlaq; Iron Age tombs near the Government offices. Placed by name.
notes: Finds in the new Municipal sewer: the Abbey of St. Mary of Jehoshaphat (reported in full as QDAP8-117), a Late Roman or Byzantine paved road from the Pool of Siloam towards Mount Zion (the pool named as a landmark, not a feature found), accumulations along the north wall; Iron Age II rock tombs near the Government offices.
